title: Integrated AI-supported quality and dose management for radiology
summary:
Computed tomography (CT) is indispensable for diagnoses, but causes high collective radiation exposure. Current systems for monitoring radiation doses usually work with rigid limits. They do not take into account whether a patient is petite or large. This leads to a dilemma: In the case of large patients, false alarms are often triggered even though the dose was necessary, while in the case of petite patients (often women), excessive doses may go unnoticed. Medical staff are overwhelmed by thousands of false alarms every year.

The IQUADORA project is developing an intelligent ‘co-pilot’ to solve this problem. The system combines two forms of artificial intelligence: Image AI automatically measures the patient, and text AI (language model) reads the medical findings to understand the medical reason for the examination. This combination enables IQUADORA to evaluate fully automatically and reliably for the first time whether the dose used was appropriate for the individual patient and the specific issue. This increases patient safety and reduces the workload for experts.
